questions.stemHtml: A research team studying vector-borne diseases is examining the epidemiology of various illnesses in a tropical region. They come across the vector depicted in the photograph provided. This vector is notorious for transmitting several diseases, which have a significant impact on public health. One of the researchers wants to confirm which of the following diseases is NOT typically transmitted by this vector. Considering the vector's species and the endemic diseases it can transmit, which disease should be excluded from the list?
